_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Kemmini d umarir {player_id}, kaḍḍan {num_rounds} n imiriren n Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Tesɛedda ${pool} i wakken ad tḥulfu ɣef umirir-agi gar kemm d umarir {other_id}.

Umarir n usudu:
  - Sudd tiddi: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ma d-yettwaqbel → Kemmini tesɛedda $(pool - X), umarir nniḍen tesɛedda $X
  - Ma d-yettwafen → Kray kemm d umarir nniḍen tesɛedda $0
  - Amedya: [Offer: $3]  neɣ  'Kemmini ḥsebɣa-d akken meqqer. [Offer: $5]'

Umarir n usentem:
  - Ṣṣayen ɣef tiddi s [Accept] neɣ [Reject]
  - Amedya: 'Yettban-d akken meqqer. [Accept]'
            'Ur yezmir ara. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Twizi {round_number} tettaɣ! ---
Anemhal {proposer_id} d asakad, Anemhal {responder_id} d asemmad.
round.accepted: Umarir {responder_id} yeqbel! Umirir {round_number} ikeccmen: Umarir {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, umarir {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Tiddi tameẓẓyant: Umarir 0: ${total_0}, umarir 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Umarir {responder_id} yefsen tiddi! Umirir {round_number} ikeccmen: Kray kemm d umarir +$0. Tiddi tameẓẓyant tesɛedda: Umarir 0: ${total_0}, umarir 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵔ ⵓⵎⵙⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵏⵏⴰⵢⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵙⵎⵔⵙ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴽⴽⵉⵍ [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵜⵉⴳ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵎⵔ ⴰⵎⴹⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⵙⴷⴰⵡⵏ.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: ⵓⴰⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴰⵍⵓⴰⵣⴰⴱ ⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵏⵔⵎⵙ.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Asakad ad ihana anɣa [Accept] neɣ [Reject] tamazirt.

outcome.win: Umarir {winner} iɛerḍen s ${winner_total} n tiddi vs umarir {loser} s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: ⵟⴰⵎⴰⵛⴰⵍⵜ! ⵉⵏⴰⵙⴾⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵓⵉⵏ ⵙⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⴰⵎⵎⵓⵜⴰⵉ ⴷⴰⵗ ${total} ⴰⴶⵓⴷⵉⵉⴰⵏ.
